lore_anchors.definition: A formation array based on the celestial pattern of the Big Dipper, used here by Han Li as an offensive tool to counter and dismantle another formation.

surfaces: Frog at the bottom of a well
lore_anchors.definition: A classic Chinese idiom for someone with a narrow, self-limiting view of the world, often used to denounce arrogance born of ignorance.
Portable magical tools used to set up or attack a formation; they are the 'hardware' of array magic, allowing a cultivator to deploy a complex spell structure over a wide area.
A classification of a formation based on the elemental energies it manipulates. This one combines the stability of Earth with the mobility and penetration of Wind.
